content.title: Component: Monitor — Operational Dashboard
content.content:
The **Monitor** (Dashboard) provides real-time operational visibility across all pipeline executions on all Ground Plex nodes. It is accessible within the Manager UI and via the SnapLogic REST API.

- Real-time pipeline execution status — running, completed, failed, queued — with drill-down to individual execution details
- Throughput metrics: documents per second, records processed, execution duration, P50/P95/P99 latency for Ultra Pipelines
- Ground Plex node health: CPU, memory, I/O per node updated every 20 seconds
- Alerting: configurable failure, SLA breach, and performance degradation notifications via email, Slack, PagerDuty, SNMP, or webhook
- Administrative actions: restart, re-trigger, cancel, and schedule management directly from the Monitor — no Designer access required for operations teams
- Native export to Dynatrace (OTel), Elasticsearch, Splunk, and Prometheus — {{customer_name}}'s existing observability tools receive SnapLogic telemetry without custom instrumentation
